name: washer-lg
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. Maintenance chapter is explicit: Regular Cleaning, Cleaning the Door Seal, Cleaning the Water Inlet Filters, Cleaning the Drain Pump Filter, Care in Cold Climates. Features chapter states 'Cleaning of the drum on a regular MONTHLY basis using Tub Clean'. Install chapter covers leveling feet and shipping bolts.

must_have.why: The manual states 'monthly' in so many words. This is the corpus's sharpest test of schedule fidelity: as_needed here is a measurable regression, not a judgement call.
Seals are named explicitly in the prompt's filters/seals list and are a common mould complaint.

should_have.why: The canonical setup task. Its cadence is the test, not its presence.
SEASONAL PREP is a NEVER DROP category and this manual has a section for it.

must_not_have.why: Operation. This is the exact class of task the curation work exists to remove.
An unboxing artifact. Fine as setup, absurd on a calendar.
